text: API agreed with Studio 2026-09-25; spec incl. answers at /private/tmp/eyes4s-shared/UI-A-UI-B-api-sketch.md (copy into the implementation PR/docs). Key points: kernel Subframe (half-open, containment by construction), LinearAngularScale tied to Frame, Correction FlipX/FlipY/Translate recorded in admission ledger (overlap = error naming both rules), StudyGeometry.Windowed + OffWindowPolicy Exclude|FailTrial, WindowTally by fixation centre and share of fixation duration, off-screen stays whole-trial quarantine with a distinct cause, tallies derived and inspectable pre- and post-run.
